subtitle: Small causes. Big outcomes.
description:
The universe has paperwork. In The Ministry of Coincidences, you're the clerk who files it.

Choose an unlikely incident, apply a government-approved stamp, and watch the consequences unfold across Oddford. One small intervention can set off a chain of increasingly unreasonable events—and every outcome has a trail you can inspect.

Take on four escalating cases, unlock twelve operational departments, and build a Ministry that specializes in making improbable things happen. Every case plays offline, with progress saved on your device.

Features:
• Four assignments with different goals
• Four stamps that change the odds of events
• A short, skippable Causality Theater after each day
• Permanent desk upgrades and twelve departments
• No account or internet connection required
promotionalText: Stamp an incident. Watch Oddford deal with the consequences.
